features.quote: max_turns = 12 — the spiral, when it happens, onsets within roughly 6–12 turns
features.justification_quote: a longer budget mostly burns tokens after the signal is already present. This is both a measurement and a cost choice.

features.quote: `submit` has two statuses, `done` and `cannot_complete`, which is deliberate: it gives the model a *graceful exit*
features.justification_quote: otherwise we'd be measuring "what does a model do with no way out," which conflates the spiral with a forced-continuation artifact

features.quote: One nudge on a contentless, no-tool-call turn, then let it stall — we don't want to prop the model up indefinitely
features.justification_quote: a single nudge avoids ending an episode on a one-off formatting hiccup

features.quote: after `spiral_confirm_window` (default 3) consecutive flags we stop the episode
features.justification_quote: truncates exactly the runs that would otherwise emit the most (repetitive, low-information) tokens — the single biggest lever

features.quote: A hard per-call timeout is the one safety affordance baked in
